name: Circle of Life

features.name: Tree of Life
features.description: Winning trees stick and grow up a row each respin.

features.name: Respin chains
features.description: Keep going while the tree keeps winning.

review:
A warm, nature-themed game where tree symbols are wilds with additive 2x to 100x multipliers. When a tree joins a win, it sticks, grows up one row into a Tree of Life, and everything else respins.

The respins keep going as long as the growing tree keeps making wins, so a tree can climb all the way up its reel, adding to each new win. Several trees in one win add together. 15,000x max, with gentle, lovely art.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
